about.en: Charles Sturt University, established in 1989, is one of Australia's premier recognized universities, holding a prominent global position (Rank 801 QS World University Rankings 2025 (#1 in Australia for Graduate Employment Rate)). The university delivers world-class academic education and cutting-edge research in close collaboration with leading global industries, offering international students a dynamic multicultural campus and exceptional graduate career prospects.
about.id: Charles Sturt University didirikan pada tahun 1989 dan merupakan salah satu universitas terkemuka di Australia yang diakui secara global (Rank 801 QS World University Rankings 2025 (#1 in Australia for Graduate Employment Rate)).
